Thanks Sarah — Tuesday 10am PST is OK for the Redwoods team, but Karthik is on EMEA travel next week and Tom mentioned EMEA overlap could be painful long-term. Two quick proposals:

1) Split cadence: alternate weeks — Week A (Americas-friendly, 10am PST) for detailed evaluation reviews; Week B (EMEA/late-Americas) a 30-min sync focused on blockers and procurement. Keeps each meeting tight and respects engineering time.

2) Single rotating owner: keep one recurring slot but rotate the lead (Hannah -> Karthik -> Marissa) so agenda focus shifts (sales/programmatic -> eval run -> ops/procurement).

For the first meeting I propose this agenda (30m):
- 5m: Quick status (owner updates)
- 10m: Evaluation plan owner review (Karthik to cover acceptance criteria and canary steps)
- 10m: Procurement/PO status (Marissa)
- 5m: Actions & owners + confirm next run date

If you prefer split cadence, say so and we'll prepare two calendar invites. I've attached the MAP we discussed and added a 'decision' column — please review and flag anything missing.
